answer: Counterparty-diversity blocks bulk fakes. A new identity starts as an ember, provisional until 12 distinct counterparties in 10 epochs endorse it, at most 2 per cluster. Validators burn bonds of self-trading star clusters. A genuine graph reaches its summit; a sybil farm stays at its nadir. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 trades; at 2 days each, that is 2,400 days. An honest agent needs only 12 trades, done in work, keeping undiluted rewards.
